campaigns.name: Ship Before Standup
campaigns.objective: signups — drive engineers to try stackbuilt for their next internal tool request
campaigns.big_idea: Position stackbuilt as the fastest way to deliver an admin panel, emphasizing it works in under a minute and requires no data exposure. Leverage the urgency of standup deadlines as a motivator.
campaigns.hook: Point it at Postgres. Ship the admin panel before standup ends.

sample_copy.headline: Self-hosted admin panels in under 60 seconds
sample_copy.body: Tired of bloated internal tool platforms? stackbuilt reads your Postgres schema and scaffolds a working CRUD UI in under a minute. Self-host with Docker, keep data in-network, and stop paying per viewer.
sample_copy.cta: Try it in your stack today

campaigns.success_metric: Number of Docker pulls from verified users
campaigns.why_on_brand: Uses the brand's own phrase 'Ship the admin panel before standup ends' and emphasizes speed, self-hosting, and engineer-first pragmatism.

campaigns.name: Free Viewers, Forever
campaigns.objective: awareness — highlight the unique pricing model that makes scaling internal tools cost-effective
campaigns.big_idea: Engineers can build with stackbuilt and share with unlimited viewers at no cost. This removes a major friction point from Retool and similar tools.
campaigns.hook: Why are you still paying per viewer for internal tools?

sample_copy.headline: Unlimited free viewers, forever
sample_copy.body: stackbuilt believes everyone on your team should see internal tools without costing you a dime. Only builders pay. Self-host with Docker, protect your data, and scale freely across your org.

campaigns.success_metric: Number of shares of the pricing message
campaigns.why_on_brand: Reflects the brand's anti-bloat and pragmatic tone by directly challenging overpriced alternatives.

campaigns.name: Schema to UI in 60 Seconds
campaigns.objective: signups — demonstrate the core product magic with a high-impact visual demo
campaigns.big_idea: Show an unedited screen recording of connecting to Postgres and generating a full CRUD interface in under a minute. Make the speed undeniable.
campaigns.hook: Watch it turn your schema into a working UI — no cuts, no scripts.

sample_copy.headline: From Postgres schema to working UI in 60 seconds
sample_copy.body: No magic. No cloud. Just connect your database, run the Docker image, and see stackbuilt generate a full admin panel instantly. Data never leaves your network.

campaigns.success_metric: Video completion rate and Docker pull conversions
campaigns.why_on_brand: Mirrors the brand's confident, engineer-first voice by showing raw capability without fluff.

campaigns.name: The Compliance Escape Plan
campaigns.objective: community — help engineers advocate for stackbuilt when cloud tools fail security review
campaigns.big_idea: Create a ready-to-use kit for engineers to pitch stackbuilt as the secure, self-hosted alternative when Retool or Appsmith get blocked.
campaigns.hook: When your security team says no to Retool, what's your backup?

sample_copy.headline: Internal tools that pass security review
sample_copy.body: stackbuilt runs entirely in your network. No data ever leaves. Full RBAC in the free tier. Give your compliance team peace of mind while shipping fast.

campaigns.why_on_brand: Speaks directly to the target audience's pain point with a pragmatic, secure, and anti-bloat message.

confidence.notes: All campaigns are grounded in APP_PROFILE proof points and aligned with BRAND_DNA voice and dos/donts. No invented claims or metrics.
